papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在解决智能体任务中技能调用不当的问题，即在相关技能被识别后，如何决定是否在当前决策点实际调用该技能，以避免引入无关上下文并干扰执行过程。为此，提出了 SelSkill 框架，它通过双粒度偏好学习来处理选择性技能调用问题，将技能使用建模为“调用或跳过”的决策，并利用预测不确定性来优先处理候选决策点，从共享轨迹前缀构建受控的调用-跳过偏好对。SelSkill 的创新之处在于结合了回合级结果偏好和步骤级调用偏好，以同时捕捉整体轨迹质量和技能调用的局部有效性。在 ALFWorld 和 BFCL 上的实验结果表明，SelSkill 在任务成功率和执行精度上均有显著提升，并且在 Tau-bench 和 PopQA 上的零样本测试表明其学习到的调用策略对新领域和未见技能具有良好的泛化能力。

papers.title: OptiWorld: Optimal Control for Video World Generation under Physical Constraints
papers.abstract: Video generation models are becoming a scalable form of world models, but they mainly generate plausible motion rather than proactively control or optimize the underlying dynamics. As a result, an object in the generated video may follow trajectories that are unsafe, not smooth, inefficient, or physically inconsistent. In this work, we propose \textbf{OptiWorld}, a framework that brings classical optimal control into video generation at inference time. OptiWorld first extracts a compact, task-relevant world state, then plans an optimal trajectory under physical constraints, and finally renders the video conditioned on this trajectory. We formulate planning as a geometric problem on a continuous manifold, which converts 3D geometry and task-dependent physical constraints into a unified planning geometry. By adding this optimal-control layer, OptiWorld generates videos with preferable dynamics, demonstrating strong potential in multiple tasks including goal-conditioned image-to-video generation, video dynamics editing, and counterfactual generation.
papers.summary_zh: 视频生成模型在生成逼真运动方面表现出色，但难以主动控制或优化底层动力学，导致生成视频中的物体轨迹可能不安全、不平滑或不符合物理规律。OptiWorld 框架通过在推理时引入经典最优控制来解决此问题，它首先提取紧凑的任务相关世界状态，然后在物理约束下规划最优轨迹，最后根据该轨迹渲染视频。其关键创新在于将规划问题表述为连续流形上的几何问题，将 3D 几何和任务相关的物理约束统一为规划几何，从而生成具有更优动力学的视频。实验结果表明，OptiWorld 在目标条件图像到视频生成、视频动力学编辑和反事实生成等任务中展现出强大潜力。

papers.title: TAPS: Target-Aware Prefix Tree Selection for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract: Using a diffusion model for parallel drafting is a promising approach for speculative decoding. By predicting tokens at multiple future positions in a single forward pass, diffusion drafters substantially reduce drafting latency. However, this shifts the bottleneck to verification: verifying a single sequence limits acceptance length, while verifying large draft trees incurs excessive target-model latency. We identify a key mismatch in existing draft-tree methods: existing diffusion-tree methods rank nodes by the marginal probability, ignoring that verification is prefix-conditioned. As a result, they may verify unreachable descendants of rejected prefixes, increasing latency with limited acceptance gains. To address this, we propose TAPS, a target-aware prefix selection method that turns diffusion marginals into path-conditioned acceptance estimates. TAPS then selects a compact prefix-closed subtree under a fixed verification budget, improving the acceptance-cost tradeoff rather than simply expanding the draft tree. Experiments across diverse datasets and model families demonstrate that TAPS achieves up to 7.9x lossless end-to-end speedup over vanilla autoregressive decoding, outperforming state-of-the-art DFlash and DDTree by 1.36x and 1.74x respectively. Our work is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TAPS-EMNLP2026-53DD
papers.summary_zh: 该论文旨在解决扩散模型在推测解码（speculative decoding）中并行草稿（parallel drafting）时，验证阶段效率低下的问题，尤其是在处理大型草稿树时。现有方法通过边缘概率对节点进行排序，忽略了验证是前缀条件（prefix-conditioned）的，导致验证了不可达的子节点，增加了延迟。为此，论文提出了TAPS（Target-Aware Prefix Tree Selection）方法，它将扩散模型的边缘概率转化为路径条件接受估计（path-conditioned acceptance estimates），并在固定验证预算下选择一个紧凑的前缀封闭子树（prefix-closed subtree）。关键创新在于TAPS通过优化接受-成本权衡（acceptance-cost tradeoff）来提高效率，而不是简单地扩大草稿树。实验结果表明，TAPS在不同数据集和模型家族上实现了高达7.9倍的无损端到端加速，相较于DFlash和DDTree分别提升了1.36倍和1.74倍。

papers.title: Short-form Text Rewriting with Phi Silica
papers.abstract: Short-form text rewriting is a constrained variant of paraphrasing in which limited context and high semantic density leave little room for variation. While large language models perform well on general paraphrasing, small language models (SLMs) often struggle with semantic fidelity and hallucination robustness in short-form settings. In this work, we present an empirical study of adapting an SLM, Phi Silica, for short-form rewrite through dataset curation, prompt distillation, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and evaluation. We curate a dataset of short presentation-style text from public slide decks and use GPT-5-chat both to generate rewrite supervision and to conduct LLM-as-a-judge evaluation. Our results show that finetuning improves semantic fidelity, reduces hallucinations, and increases preference win rate against GPT-5-chat rewrites. The findings suggest that targeted adaptation for SLMs can substantially narrow the gap to cloud models and provide practical guidance for adapting SLMs to precision-critical rewrite tasks.
papers.summary_zh: 这篇论文旨在解决小型语言模型 (SLM) 在短文本重写任务中存在的语义保真度低和幻觉问题，该任务因上下文有限和语义密度高而极具挑战性。研究通过数据集构建、提示蒸馏 (prompt distillation) 和参数高效微调 (parameter-efficient fine-tuning) 等方法，对 SLM Phi Silica 进行了适应性改造。关键创新在于利用 GPT-5-chat 生成重写监督数据并进行“LLM-as-a-judge”评估，从而在没有人工标注的情况下高效提升模型性能。实验结果表明，经过微调的 Phi Silica 在语义保真度、幻觉鲁棒性方面显著提升，并且在与 GPT-5-chat 重写的偏好对比中取得了更高的胜率，这为 SLM 在对精确度要求高的重写任务中缩小与大型云模型的差距提供了实用指导。

papers.title: Beyond Static Gaussians: An Empirical Investigation of Architectural Paradigms for Dynamic 3D Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Dynamic scene reconstruction via 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a compelling approach for representing evolving environments, yet understanding trade-offs between methodologies remains crucial. This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of dynamic 3DGS methods, categorizing them into two paradigms: structure-guided methods employing auxiliary representations (deformation fields, canonical spaces, grids) to model temporal changes, and gaussian-centric methods encoding dynamics directly into primitives via continuous functions or 4D representations. We evaluate representative methods from both paradigms on the D-NeRF benchmark. Our findings reveal that structure-guided methods achieve superior reconstruction fidelity and compact model sizes, while gaussian-centric approaches demonstrate significantly higher rendering speeds enabling real-time performance, though with greater quality variability and potentially substantial storage overhead. This analysis highlights a fundamental trade-off between reconstruction quality/compactness versus rendering speed, providing insights to guide future research and application development in dynamic scene reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh: 动态 3D 场景重建是 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 的重要应用，但不同方法间的权衡尚不明确。这项研究通过将现有动态 3DGS 方法分为“结构引导”和“高斯中心”两大范式，对它们进行了系统性分析和比较。研究发现，结构引导方法（如使用形变场、规范空间）在 D-NeRF 基准上能实现更高的重建保真度和更紧凑的模型尺寸，而高斯中心方法（如直接编码动态到基元）则展现出显著更快的渲染速度，可实现实时性能，但质量波动较大且存储开销可能更高。这项工作揭示了重建质量/模型紧凑性与渲染速度之间的核心权衡，为未来动态场景重建的研究和应用提供了指导。

papers.title: GeoSAM-3D: Geodesic Prompt Propagation for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Segmentation from Monocular Video
papers.abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D scene segmentation usually assumes RGB-D video, calibrated multi-view imagery, or a reconstructed mesh. GeoSAM-3D studies a lighter setting: a user uploads a short monocular video, clicks or names an object in one frame, and receives a propagated 3D mask over a Gaussian scene. The implementation combines frozen image and video foundation models with a monocular 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction and a differentiable graph-geodesic propagation kernel over Gaussian centroids. The central design choice is to propagate prompts by heat-kernel distance on the reconstructed scene graph, rather than by Euclidean nearest neighbors in 3D. This preserves continuity around curved surfaces and reduces leakage across nearby but disconnected objects. This paper describes the repository state, the mathematical kernel implemented in geosam3d.propagate, the feature head trained from Segment Anything masks, and the validation already present in the codebase. The evaluation protocol separates implementation validation, graph propagation quality, leakage control, and interactive latency.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在解决从单目视频进行开放词汇3D场景分割的问题，用户只需在视频一帧中点击或命名一个物体，即可获得高斯场景中的3D掩码。其方法结合了冻结的图像和视频基础模型、单目3D高斯Splatting重建以及一个在高斯中心点上可微分的图测地线传播核，关键创新在于通过重建场景图上的热核距离（heat-kernel distance）来传播提示，而非欧几里得最近邻，这有助于保持曲面连续性并减少不同但邻近物体间的泄漏。论文详细描述了代码库、数学核实现、基于Segment Anything掩码训练的特征头以及已有的验证，并通过分离实现验证、图传播质量、泄漏控制和交互延迟来评估其性能。

papers.title: Real-Time Physics Simulation with Dynamic Mesh-Gaussian Reconstructions
papers.abstract: Integrating dynamic 3D reconstructions into physics simulation requires fixed mesh topology for efficient collision detection, but state-of-the-art methods like DG-Mesh produce varying topology optimized for geometric quality. We investigate whether topology conversion can enable physics integration while preserving reconstruction fidelity. We propose a dual-representation framework combining fixed-topology meshes for physics with Gaussian splatting for rendering, achieving 4.65$\times$ speedup over varying-topology baselines through runtime vertex buffer updates. We evaluate two conversion strategies, temporal correspondence tracking and template-based projection, against native fixed-topology methods (MaGS) on the DG-Mesh dataset. Our evaluation reveals that both conversion approaches incur 65-80% geometric degradation, producing results inferior to MaGS despite DG-Mesh's superior initial quality. This demonstrates that high-quality reconstruction and physics-compatible topology represent fundamentally distinct objectives that cannot be reconciled through post-processing. Our findings inform future development of physics-aware reconstruction methods and our framework enables real-time simulation with any fixed-topology approach.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在解决将动态三维重建（如DG-Mesh）集成到物理模拟中时，由于重建结果拓扑结构可变而物理模拟需要固定拓扑结构的问题。为此，提出了一种双重表示框架，结合了用于物理模拟的固定拓扑网格和用于渲染的Gaussian splatting，并通过运行时顶点缓冲区更新实现了4.65倍的速度提升。研究评估了两种拓扑转换策略（时间对应跟踪和基于模板的投影），并与原生固定拓扑方法（MaGS）在DG-Mesh数据集上进行了比较。结果表明，尽管DG-Mesh的初始质量更高，但两种转换方法都导致了65-80%的几何退化，性能劣于MaGS，这揭示了高质量重建和物理兼容拓扑是两个根本不同的目标，无法通过后处理来调和。

papers.title: Exploiting weight-space symmetries for approximating curvature
papers.abstract: Many machine learning techniques rely on approximating a loss function's curvature, but this is notoriously hard to do at the scale of modern deep networks. Surprisingly, no previous work has exploited the curvature constraints that arise from well known weight-space symmetries in loss landscapes. By analytically averaging over group actions that leave the loss invariant, we construct structured Hessian approximations from single gradients that can be tractably estimated, stored, and inverted. The choice of user-specified symmetry group directly governs the trade-off between approximation accuracy and computational cost. Moreover, our framework provides a unifying theoretical lens for viewing existing methods; in particular, a specific choice of symmetry group recovers Shampoo/Muon-like curvature estimates. We validate our method on a range of network architectures, and deploy it to second-order optimization benchmarks, including a small language model. Our curvature estimation framework might find applications in other machine learning problems such as uncertainty estimation, continual learning, compression/pruning, training data attribution, and more.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在解决在现代深度网络中准确估计损失函数曲率的难题，而现有方法通常难以在大规模模型上实现。它创新性地利用了损失函数在权重空间中固有的对称性，通过对保持损失不变的群作用进行解析平均，从单个梯度构建结构化的Hessian近似。这种方法的核心创新在于将用户定义的对称群引入曲率估计，从而在近似精度和计算成本之间实现灵活的权衡，并且能够统一解释Shampoo/Muon等现有曲率估计方法。实验结果表明，该方法在多种网络架构上表现良好，并成功应用于包括小型语言模型在内的二阶优化基准测试。

papers.title: SDR: Set-Distance Rewards for Radiology Report Generation
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has rapidly advanced reasoning in vision--language models. However, for chest X-ray report generation, the standard rewards (i.e. exact-match accuracy and step-level processes) are incompatible because the reports consist of unordered and orthogonal findings, rather than a causal reasoning chain. We address this gap with a set-based view: each report is split into sentences and embedded by a frozen sentence transformer, yielding unordered embedding sets. We propose the use of set-to-set distances between generated and reference embeddings as continuous, permutation-invariant rewards. Across two datasets and three vision--language models (Qwen3-VL-2B/4B, Gemma3-4B), post-training with set-to-set distance based rewards via GRPO consistently outperforms supervised fine-tuning and exact-match GRPO on all headline metrics (BERTScore, RadGraph F1 and CheXbert F1 by average \%6.80, \%7.82 and \%4.45 relative improvements respectively). The same set distances also enable test-time best-of-$N$ selection: scoring candidates by their distance to training-report embeddings outperforms random selection on our trained models as well as three closed-source LLMs (Mistral-Small, Gemini-2.5 Flash-Lite, GPT-4o-mini) with on average \%16.4 relative improvement on BERTScore. Used as a streaming signal, they support a more efficient form of test-time scaling: pruning low-scoring candidates mid-generation reduces generated tokens by over 50\% while preserving the Findings quality of full best-of-$N$ selection. Together these results establish set-distance rewards as a unified signal for both post-training and test-time scaling in chest X-ray report generation. Our code is publicly \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Set-Distance-Rewards-CXR-BFDA}{available}.
papers.summary_zh: 针对胸部X光报告生成中报告内容无序且相互独立的问题，提出了一种基于集合距离的奖励机制SDR，以替代传统的精确匹配奖励。该方法将报告拆分为句子，并利用预训练的句子编码器将每个报告表示为无序的嵌入集合，然后计算生成报告和参考报告嵌入集合之间的距离作为连续、置换不变的奖励信号。在两个数据集和Qwen3-VL-2B/4B、Gemma3-4B等视觉-语言模型上，通过GRPO结合SDR进行后训练，在BERTScore、RadGraph F1和CheXbert F1等指标上均显著优于监督微调和基于精确匹配的GRPO，相对改进分别达到6.80%、7.82%和4.45%。此外，SDR还可用于测试时的“N选一”策略，通过评估候选报告与训练报告嵌入的距离来选择最佳报告，相比随机选择，在训练模型和Mistral-Small、Gemini-2.5 Flash-Lite、GPT-4o-mini等闭源LLM上，BERTScore平均相对提升16.4%，并且能通过在生成过程中剪枝低分候选来提高效率。

papers.title: Physical Object Understanding with a Physically Controllable World Model
papers.abstract: A central challenge in visual intelligence is learning the physical structure of scenes from raw videos: how regions form objects and the laws that govern their interactions. Solving these tasks requires world models capable of inferring distributional states of the world from partial observations - capabilities that current architectures do not provide. We introduce a new class of probabilistic world models that support estimation of the probability of any visual variable, such as appearance and dynamics, conditioned on any other variables. Here, we identify that these models can be trained efficiently with autoregressive sequence modeling, yielding world models from which rich object understanding emerges. First, we demonstrate that our model captures the physical laws governing how objects move by generating multiple plausible future states of the world through sequential inference. Then, by analyzing motion correlations across these futures, we extract objects and articulated object subparts. Having discovered these objects, we show that our world model can manipulate them in 3D. Finally, we demonstrate how physical relationships between objects can be computed from the world model, enabling applications such as Visual Jenga.
papers.summary_zh: 该论文旨在解决从原始视频中学习场景的物理结构，包括区域如何形成对象以及控制其交互的物理定律这一核心挑战。为此，研究引入了一类新的概率世界模型，该模型能够从部分观测中推断世界的分布状态，并通过自回归序列建模进行高效训练，从而实现丰富的对象理解。关键创新在于模型能够生成多个合理的未来世界状态，并通过分析这些未来状态中的运动相关性来提取对象及其关节子部件，并能在3D空间中操纵这些发现的对象。实验结果表明，该模型不仅能捕获控制对象运动的物理定律，还能计算对象间的物理关系，从而支持如Visual Jenga等应用。

papers.title: EST-PRM: Stress-Testing Process Reward Models Before They Become Load-Bearing
papers.abstract: Process reward models (PRMs) are widely used in language-model training with dense step-level supervision. They assume PRM scores are stable proxies for step correctness under label-preserving transformations. These transformations change reasoning structure but preserve final answers. We argue this assumption is not well validated. Such transformations can change how PRM scores relate to correctness signals, leading to different failure modes across models.To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{EST-PRM}, a stress-testing framework for dense process rewards. It applies three transformations: (1) step inflation, (2) dependency-aware step reordering, and (3) confidence markers. A vulnerability decomposition is defined that separates reward inflation from loss of correctness sensitivity. Five PRM-style models are evaluated on 4,687 reasoning chains from MATH-500, GSM8K, and PRMBench.The results indicate clear differences in vulnerability patterns across models. Math-Shepherd shows the strongest sensitivity to position perturbations, with a Pearson correlation drop of $0.152 \pm 0.038$ and a $32.8 \pm 4.9\%$ score inflation rate. Qwen2.5-Math-PRM is most affected by step inflation, reaching a $47.6 \pm 4.3\%$ inflation rate. Confidence-based perturbations also distort reward calibration, revealing inconsistencies in correctness estimation. Three mitigation strategies are evaluated, highlighting trade-offs between robustness coverage and false-positive rates.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究旨在解决过程奖励模型（PRMs）在语言模型训练中，其分数对推理步骤的正确性代理稳定性不足的问题，尤其是在标签保持转换下。为此，提出了一个名为 EST-PRM 的压力测试框架，通过应用步骤膨胀、依赖感知步骤重排序和置信度标记三种转换来评估 PRMs 的脆弱性，并定义了脆弱性分解以区分奖励膨胀和正确性敏感性损失。实验在 MATH-500、GSM8K 和 PRMBench 数据集上的 4,687 个推理链上评估了五种 PRM 风格的模型，结果显示不同模型展现出不同的脆弱性模式，例如 Math-Shepherd 对位置扰动最敏感，Qwen2.5-Math-PRM 最受步骤膨胀影响，置信度扰动也揭示了校准不一致性。研究还评估了三种缓解策略，并讨论了鲁棒性覆盖和误报率之间的权衡。
